description: Outcome each claim must produce when samples/claims is processed as one batch, in file-name order.

CLM-1001.json.scenario: Clean meal receipt; every check passes.

CLM-1002.json.scenario: Two travel receipts that add up to the claimed amount.

CLM-1003.json.scenario: Claimed amount exceeds the receipt total.

CLM-1004.json.scenario: Receipt is older than the 60-day submission window.

CLM-1005.json.scenario: Total amount extracted with low confidence.

CLM-1006.json.scenario: Lodging claim above the category limit.

CLM-1007.json.scenario: The only document is unreadable (permanent extraction failure).

CLM-1008.json.scenario: Receipt currency differs from the claim currency.

CLM-1009.json.scenario: Extraction service fails once, the retry succeeds.

CLM-1010.json.scenario: Extraction service stays unavailable; retries are exhausted.

CLM-1011.json.scenario: The same receipt is attached twice.

CLM-1012.json.scenario: Line items and tax do not add up to the printed total.

CLM-1014.json.scenario: Re-submits the receipt already claimed in CLM-1001.
CLM-1014.json.note: Batch-order dependent: flagged only when CLM-1001 was processed earlier by the same pipeline.
